title: SSC Junior Engineer JE 2025 Final Result
postName: Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Quantity Surveying & Contracts)
vacancyDetails: Junior Engineer posts in various departments under SSC JE
qualification: Diploma / Degree in Engineering as per SSC JE notification
ageLimit: As per SSC JE age limit
selectionProcess: Paper-I CBT → Paper-II → Document Verification → Final Result
documentsRequired: Roll number, registration ID; diploma/degree and photo ID for DV
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in
2. Open Results → Junior Engineer
3. Download Final Result PDF
4. Check roll number and department allocation if mentioned
shortDescription: SSC JE Engineer Final Result 2026 is out. Download final merit list from ssc.gov.in.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission has declared the SSC Junior Engineer (JE) Final Result 2026.

Candidates can download the final result / selection list from the official SSC website and note further joining instructions from the concerned department.
